# Cal TSDF Training

> Training for California treatment, storage and disposal facility workers: Cal/OSHA 40-hour HAZWOPER and 8-hour refresher, with guides to TSDF rules.

Cal TSDF Training (https://cal-tsdf.hazwoperosha.us/) sells online training from HAZWOPER OSHA Training, LLC (https://hazwoper-osha.com/). Courses are 100% online and self-paced, and each includes a certificate of completion. Prices are per seat; seats for a whole crew can be bought in one checkout. Phone +1-866-429-6742, email info@hazwoper-osha.com.

## When to use this site

- Use it when someone needs Cal/OSHA 40-Hour HAZWOPER, Cal/OSHA 8-Hour Refresher training, wants to compare those courses, or needs to know what a regulation requires them to take.
- Each course page lists the length, the price per seat, the regulation it covers, what it teaches and who it's for.
- To enroll, open a course's enroll link below. It opens the checkout on that page; payment is by card through Stripe. For an invoice or purchase order, call +1-866-429-6742 or email info@hazwoper-osha.com.
- Every page is also served as Markdown: send `Accept: text/markdown`, or add `.md` to the path (https://cal-tsdf.hazwoperosha.us/index.md).

## Courses

- [Cal/OSHA 40-Hour HAZWOPER Training (2026)](https://cal-tsdf.hazwoperosha.us/courses/cal-osha-40-hour-hazwoper-training): $229.99 per seat, 40 Hours, 8 CCR 5192(e). The 40-hour course for California sites. Enroll: https://cal-tsdf.hazwoperosha.us/courses/cal-osha-40-hour-hazwoper-training?buy=577
- [Cal/OSHA 8-Hour HAZWOPER Refresher Training](https://cal-tsdf.hazwoperosha.us/courses/cal-osha-8-hour-hazwoper-refresher-training): $149.99 per seat, 8 Hours, 8 CCR 5192(e)(8). The annual Cal/OSHA HAZWOPER refresher. Enroll: https://cal-tsdf.hazwoperosha.us/courses/cal-osha-8-hour-hazwoper-refresher-training?buy=578

## Guides

- [Training requirements for California TSDF workers](https://cal-tsdf.hazwoperosha.us/guides/california-tsdf-training-requirements): Cal/OSHA and DTSC both have something to say about training.
- [California vs federal HAZWOPER: what's different?](https://cal-tsdf.hazwoperosha.us/guides/california-vs-federal-hazwoper): Why Cal/OSHA courses exist.
